overview: Portrush Atlantic Hotel is in the heart of Portrush, overlooking the ocean and a short walk from the town's beaches. Many of its modern rooms face the Atlantic. Its restaurant and bar, Another Round, serves local dishes and puts on regular live music.
surfTripFit: Sea-facing rooms let you see conditions from the window, and the central location keeps both strands within easy reach.
